export default function LandingPage() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const [matrixCols, setMatrixCols] = useState([]); const [liveStreamLogs, setLiveStreamLogs] = useState([ "[SYS_INIT] Secure SOC pipeline connected...", "[RADAR] Scanning subnet 192.168.1.0/24...", "[HEARTBEAT] Shodan InternetDB node responding..." ]); // Generate advanced matrix code rain & telemetry simulation useEffect(() => { const cols = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i, left: `${i * 3.3}%`, duration: `${Math.random() * 4 + 2.5}s`, delay: `${Math.random() * 3}s`, text: generateCyberStream() })); setMatrixCols(cols); // Live telemetry simulation tick const interval = setInterval(() => { const simulatedTargets = ["scanme.nmap.org", "10.0.4.15", "api.netsentinel.sec", "192.168.0.1", "target-cluster-04"]; const simulatedActions = [ "RESOLVED IPv4 HOST TELEMETRY", "QUERIED SHODAN CVE DATABASE", "INDEXED CERTIFICATE TRANSPARENCY LOGS", "INSPECTED EXPOSED .ENV ENDPOINTS", "VERIFIED SSL/TLS HSTS HEADERS" ]; const randomTarget = simulatedTargets[Math.floor(Math.random() * simulatedTargets.length)]; const randomAction = simulatedActions[Math.floor(Math.random() * simulatedActions.length)]; const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString(); setLiveStreamLogs(prev => [ `[${timestamp}] ${randomAction} -> TARGET: ${randomTarget}`, ...prev.slice(0, 4) ]); }, 3500); return () => clearInterval(interval); }, []); function generateCyberStream() { const chars = "01NET_SENTINEL[SOC]#$_-SEC/TCP/IP~ACK"; let str = ""; for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) { str += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)) + " "; } return str; } const handleToolClick = (moduleName) => { const storedUser = localStorage.getItem('netsentinel_user'); if (!storedUser) { navigate('/login', { state: { from: moduleName, message: 'Authentication Required: Please login before accessing NetSentinel threat tools.' } }); } else { navigate('/dashboard', { state: { defaultModule: moduleName } }); } }; return (
